applied.problem: "A load cannot move it" is absolute: in a real transformer the flux falls a very little under load (the ignores panel says so), and later "No wire joins them" is false for the auto-transformer of i8, so both are narrowed.
"Only the flux joins two windings, so the secondary is a separate circuit" stops being true once i8 teaches the auto-transformer, whose windings share wire; narrowed to a two-winding transformer.
Screen 5's check says 440 × 10.45 comes to 4600 W, but it is 4598 W; the rounded current only gives about 4600 W, so a learner checking it by hand would be puzzled.
